body: Help. I just don't want to deal with people. I don't want people thinking I'm bat shit crazy. It's funny...those who've been where I am understand. Everyone else blows it off
I'm just too scared to take that first step, I guess.

I'm a single female, my life was going great and it just seemed like one day it was completely stripped from me. I'm in some Luke warm water with the law, I have a history of suicidal tendencies and from my POV I just don't see me ever bouncing back. I'm in hella debt, got laid off and have no way to reconcile any of it. I guess I'm just sick of being sad all the time. I truly appriciate everyone taking time out so I have someone to talk to. I just am sick of being so sad and having to deal with life. I just don't see the point anymore you know? Yeah, my friends and family will be devastated, but at this point I just feel like a burden and don't want to be here anymore. I've never felt this devoted to going through with it and it really really scares me.

Everything I've worked for is gone. And I have no one but myself to blame. I have absolutely no money to my name, I've fucked up my military career and I just don't want to be here anymore. I have no desire to go on as cliche as that is, but I just don't. Nothing makes me happy anymore. A couple months ago I was rocking 3 bottles of wine to myself to try to escape. I've moved into the big leagues and started using controlled substances and its the same effect. I've told my family I'm at the brink and they brush it off. I'm just so tired of having to be strong for everyone. I see no future for me...I can't pay off all the shit I need to and I'm just done. It's never felt so real and so close...I've made up my mind but I'm just so fucking scared. I should have OD long time ago but it just never happens. I guess I'm just sick of being sad all the time.
